title: Motion graphics: one shape, four beats
caption: A 12 second Magnifito promo built from the four spring-based motion recipes: kinetic type, a card morph, a bar chart and a logo reveal. One brand-coloured shape carries the eye from clip to clip, with real sub-frame motion blur.
prompt: Make a 12 second 16:9 motion-graphics promo for Magnifito, a Bulgarian digital marketing agency (websites, social media, email, ads, automation). Use the motion engine and all four motion recipes: open on the problem in kinetic type ("Great businesses stay invisible online"), then a service card titled "Grow with Magnifito" with four rows, then a bar chart of monthly leads before and after working with us, then close on our logo (assets/magnifito-logo.svg) with the tagline "Digital marketing with heart and value." The chart numbers are illustrative: put them in claims.json and label the chart as illustrative. Brand colours are warm browns on cream (#7a584c, #ae8c72, #f0eadf), Geist for type, English on screen.
